 #!/bin/bash
 
 set -e
 
-ENVIRONMENT=${1:-default}
+if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
+    builtin printf '%s\n' 'Usage: bash scripts/deploy.sh default|staging|production' >&2
+    exit 2
+fi
 
+case "$1" in
+    default|staging|production) ENVIRONMENT=$1 ;;
+    *)
+        builtin printf '%s\n' 'Usage: bash scripts/deploy.sh default|staging|production' >&2
+        exit 2
+        ;;
+esac
+
 echo "🚀 Deploying to $ENVIRONMENT environment..."
 
 # Run type check
 echo "🔍 Running type check..."
@@ -42,18 +53,18 @@
     # Preserve the existing enforced-mode missing-key check.
     # Required tenant-scoped identity material and safe provisioning remain pending W08.

     if grep -Eq '^AUTH_MODE *= *"enforced"' wrangler.toml; then
-        if ! wrangler secret list 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"SDK_KEYS"'; then
+        if ! wrangler secret list --env '' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"SDK_KEYS"'; then

             echo "   Safe provisioning remains pending W08 and decision D01."

             exit 1
         fi
     fi
     npm run build:meridian && npm run build:sdk
-    wrangler deploy
+    wrangler deploy --env ''
 fi
 
 echo "✅ Deployment to $ENVIRONMENT completed successfully!"
